title: Husband of Brazilian woman who 'killed three relatives with a poisoned Christmas cake' told her he wanted a divorce 24 hours before she was found dead in her prison cell
text:
The Brazilian woman’s husband accused of killing three relatives with an poisoned Christmas cake had told her that she wanted a divorce 24 hours before she was found dead in her prison cell, she emerged today.
It is said that Deise Moura Dos Anjos partner, Diego, sent a lawyer to jail in Guaiba, near the city of Porto Alegre in southern Brazil to tell him yesterday that he wanted to leave his marriage.
The 42 -year -old man suffered ‘changes in behavior’ after receiving the news, according to local media reports. It was found dead this morning during the call.
The police also confirmed to Deise, whose death is being treated as suicide, left a note in his cell claiming that he was innocent of the horror crimes of which she was accused and admitted to being depressed before hanging.
Deise was imprisoned on January 6 under suspicion of three murders and three murder attempts.
His mother -in -law Zeli Dos Anjos had baked the cake eaten by several relatives at the end of December 23 and then discovered that he was contaminated with flour with arsenic. Zeli, 61, was hospitalized but survived.
His sister teacher Maida Bernice Flores Da Silva, 58, another brother named Neuza Denize Silva Dos Anjos, 65 and the daughter of Neuza, Tatiana Silvia Dos Santos, 43, died a few hours after eating the cake afternoon the December 23.
Tatiana’s 10 -year -old son, Matheus, Zeli’s great nephew, was also taken to intensive care and spent several days in the hospital. Maida’s husband, Jefferson, also needed hospital treatment.
In the photo from left to right: Diego Dos Anjos and his wife Deise Moura, his son, and the parents of Diego Zeli and Paulo Dos Anjos
In the photo: the Christmas cake consumed by the guests on December 23
Deise Moura was found lifeless in her cell in a women’s prison in Guaiba on the outskirts of the southern city of Porto Alegre
Deise was protesting her innocence, but the police described her as an alleged ‘serial killer’ after her arrest.
Fernando Sodre, head of the State Police of Rio Grande do Sul, who leads an investigation into the death of Deise, said: “He was in a cell on his own because she was a side prisoner and to avoid any type of risk of other inmates ”
He said that Deise had hanged himself at night or morning and “was discovered dead during the morning call.”
The first policeman said he could not comment on the divorce reports because the investigators had not had time to investigate all the circumstances surrounding Deise’s death properly.
When asked if the triple murder suspect had left a suicide note, Sodre said on a Brazilian television program during an interview: ‘She left a note that we are still working on the details of the scene of her death.
“It was like a burst, saying that I was innocent, saying that it was someone who was suffering, who was depressed.”
Speaking exclusively with Mailonline, Isabel Moraes, whose brother Jefferson was married to Maida, talked about family shock.
She said: ‘We are amazed by the news. We just listened. How can this happen? Someone should have been looking at her and is only reliving the tragedy of what happened to my brother and the rest of the family again.
‘It may have avoided justice now, but hopefully, in the next life, it is being punished for all the evil and misery that caused us.
Neuza Denize Silva Dos Anjo, 65, in the photo to the left, was transferred to the hospital in critical condition before he died the next day. Maida Berenice Flores da Silva, 58, in the photo to the right, also died
Neuza’s daughter, Tatiana Silvia Dos Santos, 43, died a few hours after eating the cake
Zeli Dos Anjos (in the photo) prepared the traditional festive gift ‘Bolo de Natal’ for a family afternoon coffee on December 23 before she and six relatives, including her two sisters, fell ill
“What really hurts to all is that your child will grow without a mother, but if this is the type of woman, it may be for the better.”
The police and penitentiary authorities will now carry out separate investigations on the death of the Deise prison cell.
Police in Torres in southern Brazil, where the three victims of Veneno died, said at a press conference after his arrest, the evidence they had against her was “robust.”
Forensic experts confirmed after Deise’s arrest, the cause of the death of the victims was arsenic poisoning and said the source of pollution was the flour found in Zeli’s house in Arroio do Sol near Torres.
Margaret Mittman, director of the General Forensic Institute Rio Grande do Sul General, who covers Torres, said: ‘The source of that arsenic poisoning was the cake eaten by the victims and the source of pollution of the cake was the flour found in the Zeli’s house in Zeli’s house. Arrio do Sol.
She revealed the evidence on the samples of urine and blood of the victims, as well as the content of their stomachs, revealed “fatal levels” of arsenic up to 350 times higher than those that would be considered “naturally happening.”
He added: ‘Extremely high levels of arsenic were found in the tests carried out in the three people who died. They were levels so high that they considered themselves toxic and lethal.
Deise faced three murder positions and three murder attempts.
The Brazilian detectives said previously: “The evidence collected so far convinces us that the suspect (Moura) (s) the author of these crimes (and) will probably not leave prison in his life” (in the photo is Deise Moura)
Moura was arrested in triple homicide and attempted homicide
Before Deise’s death this morning, Brazilian detectives said they were sure that “he would probably not leave prison in his life” with the evidence they had so far.
Deise’s lawyer, Cassyus Pontes, speaking shortly after his arrest after the then confirmed reports that the evidence against her included online searches records for the arsenic who supposedly made her phone, had said: ‘Everything is very preliminary.
‘There are still questions to be answered. What is the causal link between poison and deise?
‘There is no explanation of how the flour ended in Zeli’s house, or where or how it was acquired.
‘These are minimal questions to indicate the authorship of the facts. Instead, all we have are the accounts of some family members and an alleged data extraction from a mobile phone. ”
Confirming Deise’s death in a statement today, the Regional Police said: “We can confirm that during the morning call in the prison of women of the State of Guaiba, the inmate Deise Moura Dos Anjos was found without vital signs.”
‘The staff immediately gave their first aid and called the emergency medical assistance service, which, upon reaching the scene, confirmed his death.
‘Deise was alone in his cell. The circumstances will be investigated by the Civil Police and the General Institute of Forens.
Matheus Marques, 10, Da Silva, who survived when eating the poisoned cake with Father Leonir Alves at Torres Hospital, Brazil
The police were also investigating if Deise killed his father -in -law Paulo Luis Dos Anjos (in the photo), who died last September after eating bananas mixed with milk powder that had taken him
After the shocking deaths after the findings of the arsenic, the police ordered that Mr. Dos Anjo’s body be exhumed and forensic experts confirmed that high levels of arsenic were found in their ‘stomach, nails, bladder and abdominal wall, so Like the liver ‘
The police chief Sodre said that the poisoning investigation would continue despite Deise’s death, although it can never be taken before justice after his suicide in prison, and indicated that he expected the detectives to end his Research at the end of next week.
The chief of police chief Marcus Vinicius Muniz Veloso spoke after his arrest to describe Deise as the only person who had bothered the “harmonious” family relationship that existed among the victims of poison.
He said: ‘The family relationship was harmonious, but there were disagreements caused by only one person and that person was investigated and we could build evidence that pointed to her committing three murders and three murder attempts.
‘I can tell you those differences I am talking about dates back to 20 years. They were very minor. The family told us about those disagreements.
Police were also investigating if Deise killed her father -in -law Paulo Luis Dos Anjos, who died last September after eating bananas mixed with milk powder that had taken him.
Forensic tests on Deise’s father -in -law in January after he was exhumed confirmed that he had arsenic traces inside his body.
Forensic experts had exhumed Paulo’s body of the Sao Vincento Cemetery near Porto Alegre as part of the probe they believe was fed by Moura’s long dispute with his in -laws.
Family members suspected that poisoning at that time, but his wife refused to believe it, insisting on the banana tree that the fruit came to have been contaminated after flooding in the area.
The exhumation continued after the researchers who investigated Christmas cake deaths discovered that the gift had been covered with arsenic.
